article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Vice Zanki's 14 points helped Niagara defeat Canisius 65-56 on Tuesday. Zanki shot 5 for 7, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Purple Eagles (6-17, 3-10 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Josiah Sabino scored 13 points and added eight rebounds. Justin Hawkins went 5 of 9 from the field to finish with 11 points. The Purple Eagles snapped a five-game losing streak. Bryan Ndjonga finished with 23 points and eight rebounds for the Golden Griffins (8-16, 3-10). The Golden Griffins prolonged their losing streak to eight in a row. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
